{'text': 'iPhone Duo 預計送貨日期開始大幅延後，幾乎就在預訂開放後一分鐘內發生。即使是頭幾分鐘內成功下單的顧客，預計出貨日期都已延至明年一月。', 'paragraph_context': 'Estimated iPhone Duo delivery dates started slipping dramatically, literally within a minute of pre-orders opening on Friday. Even some of those who got in within the first few minutes got estimated shipping dates into January of next year.'}

{'text': '毫無疑問，這為公司帶來難題，但有人甚至將以如此有限的庫存推出產品形容為「重大失誤」。就我個人而言，我認為這對顧客來說雖然煩人，但對 Apple 而言卻是喜憂參半……', 'paragraph_context': 'That undeniably poses problems for Apple, but some have gone as far as calling it "a major mistake" to launch with such limited stock. Personally, I\'d say it\'s annoying for customers but more of a mixed blessing for Apple …'}

{'text': 'Apple 每次推出新產品前都會先建立庫存，但面對像首款可摺疊 iPhone 這類全新產品類別，公司難以準確預測需求。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple always builds up inventory before launching new products, but with new product categories like the first foldable iPhone it can be hard for the company to predict demand.'}

{'text': '在很多方面，公司在這場供需博弈中處於一個兩難的局面。如果需求遠超供應，公司就有可能惹怒最忠實的顧客——那些願意全力支持第一代產品的消費者。但若供應超過需求，新產品隨時有貨可即時送達，評論者難免會將此視為產品失敗的證據。', 'paragraph_context': 'In many ways, the company is in a no-win position with this balancing act of supply and demand. If demand greatly exceeds supply, Apple risks irritating some of its most loyal customers – those who are willing to go all in on a first-generation product. But if supply exceeds demand, and a new product remains available for immediate delivery, commenters will inevitably point to that as evidence for it being a flop.'}

{'text': '供需平衡', 'paragraph_context': 'The balance of supply and demand'}

{'text': '事實上，我們沒有人知道真正的情況。這種失衡可能是因為 iPhone Duo 的受歡迎程度遠超 Apple 的預期（正如公司所暗示），亦可能是需求不算太高，但生產工序複雜導致供應更加有限。我個人的看法是，兩者皆有——需求相對較高，而供應則相當緊張。', 'paragraph_context': "In truth, none of us knows the true position here. The imbalance may be due to the iPhone Duo being wildly more popular than Apple anticipated (as the company implies), or it may be that demand is modest but manufacturing complexities mean that supply is even more limited. My own view is that it's likely a mixture of the two: relatively high demand and rather constrained supply."}

{'text': '需求相對較高，原因是儘管可摺疊手機整體而言仍屬小眾產品，但 Apple 明顯花了很多心思和工夫，務求將這一款打造成市場上最出色的產品。公司似乎已解決了 Android 可摺疊手機至今面對的兩大問題：明顯的摺痕及耐用性不足。公司其後更設計了能充分發揮裝置形態優勢的軟件功能，並配以一段精彩絕倫的發布影片。我覺得部分原本因為價格而卻步的消費者，在看過影片後都改變了主意；已經很久沒有見過一款新 Apple 產品引起如此熱烈的迴響。', 'paragraph_context': "Relatively high demand because, while foldables in general are still a rather niche product, it's very clear that Apple put in a lot of thought and work into making this one the best on the market. The company has seemingly addressed the two main issues that beset Android foldables to date: a visible crease and poor durability. The company then created software features to take full advantage of the form factor of the device, and topped it off with an absolutely superb launch video. I think some of those who had previously ruled it out on the basis of price changed their minds once they saw it; It's been a long time since we've seen such excitement levels around a new Apple product."}

{'text': '供應相當緊張，因為這部裝置結構複雜，尤其是鉸鏈部分，令生產難度極高，良率亦很可能偏低。', 'paragraph_context': "Rather constrained supply because it's clear that the complexity of the device, and most especially the hinge, means that it's very difficult to manufacture, and it's likely that yield rates are relatively low."}

{'text': '喜憂參半', 'paragraph_context': 'A mixed blessing'}

{'text': '當今世界最大的問題之一，是意見的兩極化。大部分人似乎已忘記了兩件截然不同的事情可以同時成立這個事實。', 'paragraph_context': 'One of the biggest problems of the world we live in today is polarization of views. Large swathes of the population seem to have lost sight of the fact that two different things can be true at the same time.'}

{'text': 'Steve 的熱門留言', 'paragraph_context': 'Top comment by Steve'}

{'text': '我認為 Apple 從未在任何 iPhone 開售後就「銷量」作出回應。因此這次需求必定是非同凡響，亦正是那些一月出貨日期的完全原因。', 'paragraph_context': 'I don\'t think Apple has ever commented on "sales" after any iPhone release ever. So this demand must be extraordinary and the complete reason for those Jan shipping dates.'}

{'text': '沒錯，在 10 月內數分鐘內下單預訂，卻要等到 1 月才收到貨，確實令人煩躁和沮喪。如果我身處同樣情況，肯定會對 Apple 大為不滿。', 'paragraph_context': 'Yes, pre-ordering a product in October within minutes and then having to wait until January to receive it is both annoying and frustrating. If I were in that position, I would absolutely be pissed at Apple.'}

{'text': '但同樣地，送貨日期即時延後，亦為這款大受歡迎的新產品增添話題，令其熱潮進一步升溫。', 'paragraph_context': 'But also yes: this immediate slipping of delivery dates adds to the narrative of a wildly popular new product, serving to further boost the hype around it.'}

{'text': '若 Apple 能準確預測需求，最理想的做法大概是在產品被視為成功與顧客不致生厭之間取得平衡——送貨時間有所延後，但又不至於令顧客煩躁。這個情況無疑並不完美，但在我看來，與其說是策略失誤，不如說是喜憂參半。', 'paragraph_context': "If Apple could have perfectly predicted demand, then it would likely have wanted a position where delivery times slipped sufficiently for the launch to be viewed as a success, but not so much that customers get annoyed. This situation isn't ideal, for sure, but in my view it's more of a mixed blessing than a strategic error."}

{'text': '最後，如果你正面對漫長的等貨期，現實情況可能不如想像中糟糕。Apple 一開始傾向給顧客最保守的日期，其後往往會提前。此外，零售店員告訴我，由於網上與實體店銷售預測不準確，加上不同店舖的需求有差異，部分門市不時會有預期外的現貨可供即場購買。新產品開售翌日開始，不妨親身到店碰碰運氣。', 'paragraph_context': "Finally, if you are the position of having been given a lengthy wait for your order, the reality may not be quite as bad as it appears. Apple tends to present customers with the worst case dates initially, often bringing them forward subsequently. Additionally, retail staff tell me that there will often be unexpected walk-in stock available at some stores, again due to imperfect forecasting of online versus offline sales, as well as varying demand at different stores. That's always worth trying from the day after the new devices go on sale."}
